text: One booking record connects scheduling, clinic queue, consultation progress, and the final medical record.
appointments: stores the selected pet, service, veterinarian, date, time, and booking status
queue_entries: tracks same-day check-in, queue number, and the live visit status
doctor_appointment_state: keeps clinical notes and consultation progress private to clinic users
medical_records: stores the finalized diagnosis, treatment, prescription, and follow-up
Doctors prepare educational content as private drafts, then publish it to the clinic-wide health feed.
health_post_drafts: stores unfinished content that only the doctor account can access
health_posts: stores published, scheduled, or archived posts for the app and web portal
Access control: doctors and staff can publish; owners can read the shared clinic feed

A shared inventory record keeps product information, stock quantity, expiry dates, and movement history together.
inventory: stores products and clinic supplies in one table for the mobile app and web portal
Stock control: records stock in, stock out, and adjustments with previous and new balances
Monitoring: supports low-stock warnings, expiry checks, restock requests, and archived items
Write access: staff, doctors, and administrators
